	"text": "CANON — QUEEN SUNDUK — FACE and garments from attached /ch_sunduk.png (face only; invent a new pose). Hair ornament matches attached /bn_sunduk.png when the head is visible. Look: Pale oval face, dark calm eyes; black hair in a full coiled updo; when crowned, the gold Silla tree-and-antler crown hung with jade gogok. Dress: Crimson court robe with gold phoenix brocade, blue embroidered cape-collar, a red ribbon bow at the chest. Crown: Silla gold crown, as the attached crown: a gold band with three tree-shaped uprights stepped like the character 出 and two antler uprights at the back, hung with round gold spangles and curved green jade gogok, long gold pendants at the temples. ref_muyeol shows it worn with the king's red robe and gold-scroll collar (ignore its painted backdrop). Demeanor: Composed, faint smile, wit in the eyes; looks up at the sky (Cheomseongdae). Never weepy, never cowed. #E8552B as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: Tang empress costume; fantasy tiara in place of the Silla gold crown. | KIM YUSHIN — FACE and garments from attached /ch_kim_yushin.png (face only; invent a new pose). Look: Tall, broad-shouldered, long black hair in a high topknot-ponytail with trailing Silla-blue cloth tails; level hard brows, deep-set eyes. Dress: Silla-blue po and trousers, plum-violet sash knotted at the waist, white inner collar, dark wrapped forearms. Off duty: plain blue po, no jewelry. Headwear: the jougwan (see HEADWEAR). As a hwarang he keeps the crescent-moon headband across the brow, its tails trailing; the jougwan sits on the crown of the head above it. Now: Marshal: full black beard and moustache; a blue ribbon in the topknot instead of the headband. Demeanor: Confucian: he STANDS — never sits in lotus. Weighs, counts, frowns at sums; tight jaw, rare dry half-smile. Grief shows as stillness, not tears. The most feared warrior in all of Samhan: a line goes quiet when the tall Silla helm and the white horse appear. Massive, deliberate, terrifying at a walk; by Hwangsan (65) heavier and slower than Gyebek but still the man armies are built around. #2A5FB8 as the hard key / specular / bounce in the dark — real light, never a glow aura or body halo. Never: sitting in lotus or holding prayer beads; katana, tsuba or curved blade (ignore the sword drawn on his portrait); two swords at once; blue glow aura. | PLACE Cheomseongdae (첨성대) — attached board /pl_observatory.png; keep this exact architecture and ground. Cheomseongdae: the bottle-shaped stone star tower on a grass field under the night sky. | HEADWEAR: JOUGWAN (조우관, feather cap) — copy the SHAPE from the attached hat boards and ignore their Korean labels, museum photos, paper-craft gems and dragon medallion: a small black lacquered gauze cap (변형모, a peaked or square-topped crown no bigger than the topknot it covers) set high on the crown of the head over a small knot of gathered hair (any loose hair the portrait shows still falls beneath it); a thin black band round the head with a small square opening at the front; black cords tied under the chin; two long barred pheasant tail feathers (tan with umber bars), or a spray of bird plumes, rising straight up or sweeping back from either side of the cap, much taller than the cap itself. It replaces any other hat or cap on the portrait; headbands and ribbons stay. Real lacquer and feathers lit by the scene key, never a glow. | COSTUME CHARTS (attached): cut, collar, sleeve, sash, trouser and skirt shapes of every Samhan figure follow the chart for their kingdom; it is a style chart, so ignore its labels, captions, maps, poses and faces. Named people keep their portrait face and colours; extras and soldiers dress like the chart (a commoner like its commoners, an official like its officials, a soldier like its soldiers). Silla: attached /ref_hanbok_silla.png."
